description: This Java class 'StatusServices' provides service methods for retrieving status items and valid status change details within the Apache OFBiz framework. It interacts with entity data and utility classes to perform its functions.

classes.name: StatusServices
classes.description: Service class providing methods to fetch status items and change details in OFBiz.

methods.name: getStatusItems
methods.description: Retrieves a list of status items based on provided status type IDs, handling errors and localization.

methods.name: getStatusValidChangeToDetails
methods.description: Fetches valid status change details for a given status ID, returning success or error.
